response.rationale: R1 best integrates the large chest plaque with the extensive prior systemic immunomodulatory treatment history and treatment-response/laboratory monitoring context. R4 shares the same plaque phrase but lacks the lupus-specific raw findings such as follicular plugging, scarring, or photosensitivity. R3 is only a generic erythema/plaque overlap without a clear painful refractory course, and R2 has no raw support span.
